note: 符文专家，来花园讨西瓜；玩家是供货者；习惯用 Dusk 自称；一本正经的怪趣味；必须保留第三人称自称。

messages.raw: §fDusk needs some watermelon to quench his thirst. Dusk would appreciate it.
messages.text: Dusk needs some watermelon to quench his thirst. Dusk would appreciate it.
messages.zh: Dusk 想吃点西瓜解渴。Dusk 会很感激。

messages.raw: §fDusk thanks you. Dusk will make sure to visit your farm again.
messages.text: Dusk thanks you. Dusk will make sure to visit your farm again.
messages.zh: Dusk 谢谢你。Dusk 一定还会来你的农场。
